pr_body:
We expect the values of CounterMetric to be non-negative when serializing them over the wire, but Yannick discovered that this does not always hold (see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/52411). The reason is that the returned value of a LongAdder is not an atomic snapshot.

We can replace LongAdder with AtomicLong, but this commit continues using LongAdder but returns 0 when the value is negative instead.

Relates #52411
Closes #70968
pr_title: Avoid return negative value in CounterMetric

review_comment: can you add a comment why count is supposed to only return `>= 0`
